name: icelandic-grammar-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for Miðeind's Málfríður Icelandic grammar and spelling API.
long_description: An unofficial MCP server that gives Claude a check_icelandic_grammar tool, powered by Miðeind's Málfríður proofreading service through the Málstaður API. Requires an API key created under a Frjáls áskrift at malstadur.mideind.is. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Miðeind ehf.

tools.name: check_icelandic_grammar
tools.description: Check Icelandic text with Málfríður and return its corrected text verbatim, without additional edits or rewriting.

api_key.title: Málfríður API Key
api_key.description: API key created under your Frjáls áskrift at malstadur.mideind.is.
